title: Ticketmaster - blocks electron browserfrom entering presale code
body:

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

latest

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

Windows 11 latest

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

n/a

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

having an issue with ticketmaster on electron 

if you go to this page - https://www.ticketmaster.com/dylan-scott-philadelphia-pennsylvania-02-04-2027/event/0200652AE3A47089

and click unlock and enter any presale code, you get a message stating browsing activity paused, i dont get this at all on other browsers, it seems to be detecting something different with electron

### Actual Behavior

it should say invalid/valid presale code

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

A minimal sandboxed BrowserWindow using a fresh in-memory session, no preload, no proxy, no request interception and no automation receives HTTP 403 {"response":"block"} from Ticketmaster’s offer-code validation endpoint. The same account, network, event and code work in Chrome and Edge. Tested with Electron 44.4.1 / Chromium 152.0.7977.78.
